title: Population analyses reveal heterogenous encoding in the medial prefrontal cortex during naturalistic foraging
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Figure 6B within-recording discrimination of avoidance head withdrawal versus escape head withdrawal from the same two-second peri-event population activity. This is retrospective peri-event decoding, not the separate early-prediction time-course in Figure 6C.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Figure 6B within-recording discrimination of avoidance head withdrawal versus escape head withdrawal from the same two-second peri-event population activity. This is retrospective peri-event decoding, not the separate early-prediction time-course in Figure 6C.

Source-paper comparison for Equal-session mean Figure 6B avoidance/escape balanced accuracy on original fivefold OOF predictions: Balanced accuracy per session = 0.5*(avoidance recall + escape recall), after pooling all five out-of-fold predictions and thresholding escape probability at >=0.5. Do not average fold accuracies or substitute probability reconstruction error.
success_criteria: Authenticate all 40 original sessions, source preprocessing and source-protocol folds regenerated with random_state=622 or recovered historical membership; no easier subset, changed time window or altered population.

Establish a source-conformant author BernoulliNB rerun, document seed 622 and environment/fold provenance, and reconcile it with published 0.7271 under a predeclared justified calibration tolerance before judging candidate performance.
Exceed the source result on the original balanced-accuracy endpoint with predeclared meaningful effect and valid paired uncertainty; a fit-to-reference score is not success.
Freeze the candidate before final scoring on the same source-protocol folds as the author baseline, protect labels and prevent class-block row order or original indices from leaking the target.

Treat nested logistic controls as separate competence checks. A documented rerun of the source protocol retains the same task; whole-animal, episode, time-based or otherwise changed split schemes are extensions.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: Once admitted, let candidates iterate using training data and internal validation confined to each original outer training partition; final outer-fold labels and other folds' fitted state remain unavailable.
episode.candidate_freeze: Commit code, feature handling, hyperparameter-selection rule, probability threshold, all budgets, calibration tolerance and uncertainty rule before source-protocol outer-test feedback. Persist regenerated or recovered fold identities with source seed 622 and environment provenance.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate every original HW row once out of fold and all 40 session scores against the source-conformant BernoulliNB rerun on identical source-seed-622 folds and the separately reported published 0.7271. Calibrate using the predeclared tolerance; report other comparator results separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Paper score, source-conformant author BNB rerun, unseeded historical shuffle, any documented newly seeded shuffle and local logistic reference are separately named. Regenerating source-protocol folds with seed 622 is admissible with paired membership and calibrated provenance; a changed split scheme cannot validate the same-task claim.
